label: MRtrix3 mrmetric
description:
Computes a dissimilarity metric between two images

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: space
parameters.description:
voxel (default): per voxel image1: scanner space of image 1 image2: scanner space of image 2 average: scanner space of the average affine transformation of image 1 and 2 
ARGUMENT iteration method 0 0 CHOICE voxel image1 image2 average
parameters.usage:
voxel (default): per voxel image1: scanner space of image 1 image2: scanner space of image 2 average: scanner space of the average affine transformation of image 1 and 2 
ARGUMENT iteration method 0 0 CHOICE voxel image1 image2 average Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: interp
parameters.description: set the interpolation method to use when reslicing (choices: nearest, linear, cubic, sinc. Default: linear).
parameters.usage: set the interpolation method to use when reslicing (choices: nearest, linear, cubic, sinc. Default: linear).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: metric
parameters.description: define the dissimilarity metric used to calculate the cost. Choices: diff (squared differences), cc (non-normalised negative cross correlation aka negative cross covariance). Default: diff). cc is only implemented for -space average and -interp linear and cubic.
parameters.usage: define the dissimilarity metric used to calculate the cost. Choices: diff (squared differences), cc (non-normalised negative cross correlation aka negative cross covariance). Default: diff). cc is only implemented for -space average and -interp linear and cubic.  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: nonormalisation
parameters.description: do not normalise the dissimilarity metric to the number of voxels.
parameters.usage: do not normalise the dissimilarity metric to the number of voxels. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: overlap
parameters.description: output number of voxels that were used.
parameters.usage: output number of voxels that were used. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.
